1.title: Welcome to Klaro
1.description: Klaro is a free service. Klaro helps you understand social support better.

2.title: You don't need to be an expert
2.description: There are many social benefits. Klaro helps you find the ones that fit your situation.

3.title: Answer a few short questions
3.description: With a few questions, Klaro checks your situation. That gives you an initial orientation.

4.title: Start the check now
4.description: The check only takes a few minutes. After that, Klaro helps you with the application. You can start right away and don't need an account yet.

nationality.title: Which of the following applies to you?
nationality.tip: This is important because different laws apply depending on your residency status. If you are new in Germany or in asylum proceedings, there is a special support system.

options.EU_5_PLUS: I am an EU citizen and have lived in Germany for at least 5 years.
options.RESIDENCE_PERMIT: I have a valid residence permit for Germany.

livesInGermany.title: Do you live in Germany?
livesInGermany.tip: You can only receive Basic Income Support if you live in Germany permanently.

options.NO: No, I do not live in Germany.

dateOfBirth.title: When were you born?
dateOfBirth.tip:
Basic Income Support may be an option for you if you:
• have reached the standard retirement age or
• are at least 18 years old and permanently fully unable to work.

pension.title: Do you receive a pension?
pension.tip: From the standard retirement age, Basic Income Support in old age may be an option for you. When you reach this age limit depends on your year of birth.

options.REDUCED_EARNING_CAPACITY: I receive a pension because I am no longer able to work full-time (Reduced Earning Capacity).
options.NONE: I do not receive a pension.

income.title: Which of the following applies to you?
income.tip: Sometimes money is enough for food, but not for the rent. Then you might get housing benefit.

options.NOT_SUFFICIENT: My current income is not sufficient to cover my needs.
options.SOON_INSUFFICIENT: I am concerned that my income may soon be insufficient.
options.SUFFICIENT: My income is sufficient. I can afford my expenses.

hasAssetsAboveThreshold.title: Approximately how much do you have in assets?
hasAssetsAboveThreshold.tip: Don't worry, many people receive help despite savings. The limit in the first year is €10,000 for one person. This includes cash, valuable items, or your car, for example.

options.YES: Yes, I have more than €10,000 in assets.
options.NO: No, I have less than €10,000 in assets.

eligible.title: You could be entitled to basic income support.
eligible.description: This is an initial assessment. Klaro helps you fill out your application step-by-step. It is easy, digital, and free.

not_eligible.title: Basic Income Support is not a good fit at the moment...
not_eligible.description: You can still create an account and save your answers securely. So you can use Klaro later when your situation changes or you need support with further steps. Later we will offer more applications!

sozialamt.title: Please contact your local Social Services Office
sozialamt.description: Based on your answers, none of the qualifying residence statuses apply. Please contact your local Social Services Office (Sozialamt) for guidance on which support may be available to you.
